spec.description:
Kingspan
Kooltherm K18 Insulated Plasterboard is a premium performance insulated
dry-lining board engineered for mechanically fixed internal wall insulation.
Combining rigid thermoset phenolic insulation with a low-emissivity composite
foil backing and a 12.5mm tapered-edge gypsum plasterboard face, it delivers
thermal conductivities as low as 0.021 W/m·K. It is designed specifically for
mechanically fixing to timber framing, metal furring channels, and timber
battens over solid masonry, brickwork, or concrete walls.
features: Engineered specifically for mechanically fixed dry-lining systems

3-in-1
integrated board: thermal insulation, vapor control, and plasterboard lining

Ultra-thin
profile retains maximum internal living space in refurbishment and new builds

Low-emissivity foil backing enhances thermal resistance across framing
cavities

12.5mm plasterboard facing provides a rigid, robust interior wall
surface
Fiber-free closed-cell phenolic core resistant to moisture passage

Straightforward mechanical screw-fixing to timber battens, steel studs, or
metal furring systems
Manufactured with zero ODP and low GWP blowing agents

technical.value:
37.5 mm, 42.5 mm, 52.5 mm, 62.5 mm, 72.5 mm, 82.5 mm, 92.5 mm (includes 12.5mm
plasterboard)

spec.fire:
Reaction to Fire Euroclass B-s1, d0 to EN 13501-1; Low
smoke generation
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP and low GWP blowing agent; fiber-free core; low VOC
emissions
install:
Install treated timber battens (minimum 25mm x 50mm)
or metal furring channels vertically at 400mm or 600mm centers

Ensure
background masonry is dry and treated with damp-proof measures where required
Cut Kooltherm K18 boards approximately 15mm short of floor-to-ceiling height

Fix boards mechanically using drywall screws driven through the plasterboard
and insulation into battens/channels

Space drywall screws at maximum 300mm
centers (200mm at corners), ensuring screw heads seat just below plaster
surface

Ensure screws penetrate timber battens by at least 25mm or steel
channels by at least 10mm

Tape and flush joints using standard jointing
compound and paper tape
selection_checklist:
Confirm mechanical batten
or furring channel fixing method is preferred over adhesive dab bonding
Select overall thickness based on target thermal performance

Ensure drywall screw lengths accommodate
board thickness plus required batten penetration
accessories:
Treated
timber battens or metal furring channels
limitations:
Must be mechanically fixed; not designed
for direct adhesive dot-and-dab fixing (use K17 for adhesive bonding)

Not
suitable for damp or unventilated solid walls without moisture treatment

Do
not use directly adjacent to combustion flues or solid fuel stoves

problem_keywords: cold interior walls in older buildings

space loss from internal wall
insulation
use_cases:
Mechanically
screw-fixing to treated timber battens or metal furring channels over uneven
solid masonry walls

Internal wall thermal upgrades in historic solid-brick or
stone buildings

Drylining ceiling slopes and partition walls requiring
mechanical attachment
not_for:
Direct adhesive dot-and-dab fixing
without battens (use K17)
retrieval.rag_summary:
Kingspan Kooltherm K18
Insulated Plasterboard is a 3-in-1 insulated dry-lining board combining rigid
thermoset phenolic foam (conductivity 0.021 W/m·K), a low-emissivity composite
foil backing, and a 12.5mm tapered-edge gypsum plasterboard face.
Purpose-designed for mechanical screw-fixing to timber battens, metal furring
channels, or studs over solid masonry and concrete walls, it provides thermal
ratings up to R3.8 while preserving interior room dimensions. Euroclass B-s1, d0
fire rated and fiber-free, it delivers robust, moisture-resistant internal wall
insulation.
